title: Claims of secret ships to Europa heard at Contact in the Desert
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Claims of secret ships to Europa heard at Contact in the Desert, about present at Contact in the Desert conference / Europa, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Contact in the Desert conference / Europa

tellings.quote: It could be possible we're sending ships to Europa on a regular basis

plain: An author named Peter Levenda told the podcast host Jesse Michels about claims he heard at Contact in the Desert, a UFO conference. According to Levenda, people there suggested it could be possible that ships are being sent on a regular basis to Europa, an icy moon of Jupiter. If true, it would mean a hidden space program reaching far beyond anything the public knows about.
